english.title: Pilot participate in flying display in breach of or without authorisation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person acting as pilot of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), participating in a flying display failed to

(A)_[hold an appropriate pilot display authorisation]_
(B)_[comply with a condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), subject to which a pilot display authorisation had been given]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Articles 86(4) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
